name: Mannitol
siboNotes: Mannitol is poorly absorbed and rapidly fermented by gut bacteria, making it particularly problematic for SIBO patients even in very small amounts.
preparationTips: Always check ingredient lists on sugar-free products
Look for 'E421' on European product labels
Be aware it's often combined with other sugar alcohols
Even small amounts can trigger symptoms
pairsWellWith: Try small amounts of pure maple syrup
nutritionalHighlights: Acts as a laxative in larger amounts
Not metabolized by oral bacteria (won't cause tooth decay)
Used medically as an osmotic diuretic
